$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-progress-circle) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

track.$why: Figma draws the ring as an ellipse with an 80 % inner radius, filled; the code strokes an SVG circle (stroke, not fill), so the colour is not readable as a fill. The pixels cover it.

indicator.$why: As the track: an SVG stroke from 12 o'clock; the pixels cover its colour and its 25 % arc.
